posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
So according to steam I have played 200 hours of Sentinels of the Multiverse: The Video Game, that's a lot of video game!

 

But it's not enough. I am going to try and kick up my SotM: TVG playing to try and reach 365 hours of game play this year, that's enough for 1 hour every day for an entire year.

By my calculations that means if I was to play every day from now until January 1st I would need to play about 3 hours a day, so that's the plan. Who's going to help me reach this target? And who else can reach this (entirely stupid and arbitrary) target as well?

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Another week, another update.

I am up to 253 hours, well up on where I want to be, and that's even having a day where I couldn't play thanks to crappy internet.

The addition of the new mini pack has lead to their being a lot more people online, lots more variety in the people I get to play with. I have yet to unlock any of the new variants but I have seen them played, and couldn't resist putting in the front to see new dialogue (though I haven't tried an Ambuscade game with Eternal haka, must do that) Lots of people want to play around in the Final Wasteland, at first I thought there was a problem with the worm as I had a game where there was 12 cards inteh deck but we had 4 rounds where it was the worm every time, but it seems to have just been a fluke.

Somehow I feel this quest might be better spent doing something else, like 3 hours a day on a bike to get fit or something, but this is far more fun.  I've seen 2 non-standard gameover screens thanks to the wasteland, and I've worked out what Guise's icon is on the Scholar's incap* so I don't feel I've waste my time at all.  Huzzah for time wasting fun!

 

*It's the symbol that browsers/OS's show when they can't display a picture!

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
Another week and another report for my adoring fans. I know you are here for my numbers and not Silverleaf's hat.

Had a pretty terrible week so far as my time was concerned, I lost 5 days! I realised there was an error in my formula, I was counting from the day I bought the game, not the start of the year. It changed the hours needed each day from 2.6 to 3.01, so still just within the 3 hours per day I previously had but now I can't skip a day if things come up. The sacrifices I must make to reach my goal are as horrible as they are numerous.

I've currently got 271 hours under my belt, so I've passed the 100 hour point now, everything should be downhill from now on. Here's hoping Handelabra don't release Kismet or Setback to jinx me now!

posts.name: Sonvar
posts.cooked: If you fall behind you should ask them to send Omnitron-X or Chrono Ranger.

posts.name: Matchstickman
posts.cooked:
What do marathon runners and I have in common?

Apart from amazing physical fitness, we both know the dread of "the wall". This week I have been feeling the fatigue set in from having to play so much Sentinels every day, it's really such a chore you know.

I thought about admitting defeat and just stopping so I didn't come to resent playing, but instead I pulled back and played less hours this week. I still have a buffer from overplaying earlier so it isn't like I'm behind yet, but I can see the spectre of defeat getting ever closer now.

I think I will be counting down rather than up from here on out, it makes the totals involved look more manageable.

79 hours to go!
